set.body:
Owner: ScalaFIM design/fit product contracts and selected execution. Consumer requirement: PLS Neuro epic bd-01M1ZAMMWZCNK5C9CXCVZ1WYTS / SE4 bd-01M1ZBE6FA991N16Q3S8ZXCMM5 in /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/scala/plsneuro. Foreign IDs are provenance only.
The current selected request treats every output as a member of the final coefficient axis. Shared OLS can explicitly select nuisance columns, but run-local nuisance columns are absent from the pooled axis and FirstLevelFixedEffectsEstimates.prepare rejects them through alignTo. This preserves estimand identity but does not yet fulfill optional nuisance-map retention alongside pooled condition/FIR/contrast estimates. The selected guide adds a public-API example test of this current refusal; execution evidence is pending.
Implement a typed optional run-local retained product distinct from pooled outputs. Keep nuisance retention off by default. Reuse the existing run QR coordinates/factors, avoid full-fit or unrequested run maps, preserve run/column/voxel identities and cancellation/sink ownership, and do not alter full joint-precision pooling or its required internal variance. Preparation must report actual extra retained work and unsupported combinations. Do not relabel a run-local coefficient as a shared effect.
Acceptance: independent run-coefficient oracle, equality of pooled estimates and exclusions with retention on/off, exact run/column and FIR identity, bounded block reads, absent unrequested nuisance maps, cancellation/failure behavior and JVM/Scala.js tests. Document the public request and output capabilities and provide a compiled/executed example. Consumer admission and workbench controls remain in PLS Neuro SE4; durable formats remain with ScalaFIM IO and its existing publication boundary.
set.title: Retain run-local nuisance estimates alongside pooled outputs
